record: Co-led the Protecting Kids from Human-Like Chatbots Act, limiting human-like chatbot behaviour toward minors by default.
Introduced the GENESIS Act to codify the Genesis Mission executive order on AI-driven scientific research at the National Laboratories.
grade_reason: He has spoken about AI in 2026 (child safety around chatbots, copying Utah's AI regulatory sandbox federally) and 2025 (promoting AI for science), but nothing found acknowledges catastrophic risk from AI.
notes: All required searches ran this time: 7 web searches (the six required plus one on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors). No statement by him on superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, a pause or slowdown, or an agreement with China was found. He is not among the House cosponsors of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538) listed by FastDemocracy (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/), page not opened. The earlier attempt also opened his press release listing pages 1 to 7 on mikekennedy.house.gov (back to early 2025); only the chatbot and GENESIS Act releases mention AI in a way relevant here. Deseret News (2026-04-08) and KSL (2026-04-09) quote him only on Utah's regulatory approach ('healthy approach', 'helpfully directive', 'not destructive'); the reporter's paraphrase that his approach includes consumer guardrails was left out. The Algorithm Accountability Act (November 2025, with Rep. McClain Delaney) concerns social media algorithms and was not added. His site lists a June 2025 'Regulating AI' podcast appearance, but the episode itself was not checked. An American Bazaar article (2025-04-15, 'AI can transform healthcare but regulation must be precise') returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Articles about Senator John Kennedy (Louisiana, AI 'kill switch' bill) are a different person and were excluded.
